cards.text: Jesus has just answered the Pharisees so well that nobody dares question Him anymore. Now He turns to the crowds and His disciples and talks about the scribes and Pharisees, the teachers of the law and the religious leaders. He starts by saying they sit in Moses' seat.

cards.question: Since the scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses' seat, Jesus tells the crowds to ignore everything they teach.

cards.text: So practice what they tell you. BUT. Here comes the catch, friend. Follow the recipe card, just don't copy the baker.

cards.question: Why does Jesus tell the crowds not to do what the scribes and Pharisees do?

answers.text: They do not practice what they preach
They copy the customs of foreigners
They change the law every single year

cards.text: Then Jesus paints a picture. They tie up heavy loads and lay them on people's shoulders. You know the coworker who stacks a mountain of work on your desk, says "You got this," and leaves at five without touching ONE page?

cards.question: The scribes and Pharisees lay heavy loads on people's shoulders. How much do they help move them?

answers.text: They will not lift a finger
They carry half of the load
They help only on feast days

cards.question: Jesus says all the deeds of the scribes and Pharisees are done for ___ to see.

cards.text: And they make SURE people see. They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels. That's turning your name tag into a billboard. HELLO, MY NAME IS VERY, VERY HOLY.
Oh, and they LOVE the spotlight. Jesus starts listing what they love, and friend, the list keeps going.

cards.question: At banquets, which places do the scribes and Pharisees love?
Jesus says the scribes and Pharisees love being greeted in the marketplaces.

cards.text: Last on the list, they love being addressed by the title Rabbi. Me? I'd take any title. For years in that junk drawer, I was "the thing under the takeout menus."
Now Jesus turns it around and talks to His own followers. He says you are not to be called Rabbi.

cards.question: Why does Jesus say His followers are not to be called Rabbi?

answers.text: They have one Teacher and are all brothers
The title belongs only to the priests
They have not studied long enough yet

cards.question: Jesus says not to call anyone on earth your father, because you have one ___, who is in heaven.
Jesus tells His followers not to be called instructors either. Who does He say is their one Instructor?

cards.text: Then Jesus flips the whole ladder upside down. Everybody's been racing for the top seat. Turns out the top looks a LOT different than they thought.

cards.question: According to Jesus, who is the greatest among His followers?

answers.text: The one who is your servant
The one with the best seat
The one who teaches the most

cards.question: Whoever exalts himself will be ___, and whoever humbles himself will be ___.

cards.text: And we'll pull this batch out of the oven right there. But friend, Jesus is NOT done talking to the scribes and Pharisees. Not even close.
